core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haadii corresponds to the Arabic form هادي (Arabic root ه د ي (h-d-y); هادٍ (hādī)). Its core sense is guide, leader. Haadii is a transliteration of Arabic هادي (Hādī) 'guide'. The source's own gloss 'delight, pleasure' is not the sense of this form (it was carried over from the unrelated هُدَى/هدية family); the guiding sense belongs to ه د ي. Same name as haadi and haadee.
